notes.title: New release window: Q2 2026
notes.notes: [p]I was pushing hard to finish the game in time for the planned release around October 2025. But as we are in middle of September already it's quite obvious that this won't happen.[/p][p]To be honest I've put almost 5 years into this game, and don't really want to release it in unfinished and unpolished state just to hit the release date.[/p][h3][b]So I've made the hard decision to postpone the launch window to Q2 2026![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Meanwhile there will be another announcement above a [b]fully revamped demo[/b] version with all of the updates to the gameplay, player weapons, enemies and visuals that I’ve made the last couple of years.[/p][p]This will come [i]pretty soon[/i], probably in month or so![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Leaderboards added to the demo version
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114476/772575690afc00719d15969341426107771c1f2a.png[/img]

Hey everybody, just for the upcoming Steam Next Fest the demo version of The Battle for Vega was update with online leaderboards (powered by Steam)!

Now every successful Arcade run gives up placement both in the Hi-Score Leaderboard, but in the Best Time Leaderboard as well.

You can see your placements in the Arcade start page, and in the brand new Leaderboards page in the Home Menu.

Enjoy!

notes.title: Battle for Vega official demo version is out!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44114476/79cb2f279ec2715cdb4162dab31bf5fb2ba4f1af.jpg[/img]

 [h2]What is The Battle for Vega?[/h2]

Inspired by the classic Space Invaders, [b]The Battle for Vega[/b] takes the old-school gameplay you know and love and adds new features that make it a fresh and exciting experience.

In [b]The Battle for Vega[/b], you'll face off against waves of enemies and bosses across multiple star systems. Each enemy type has a unique weapon, so you'll need to strategize and adapt to their attacks if you want to survive. But don't worry – you'll have plenty of weapons of your own to choose from.

Every player ship type has different hardpoints that you can equip with different weapons classes and types. Choose from a wide range of options, including lasers, missiles, and more. As you progress through the game, you'll be able to upgrade your ships and weapons for better stats and performance. Will you focus on firepower or speed? [b]The choice is yours.[/b]

But be careful – the enemies in [b]The Battle for Vega[/b] are relentless, and they won't give up without a fight! You'll need to be quick on your feet and even quicker with your trigger finger if you want to make it through to the end.

With its classic gameplay, modern upgrades, and challenging levels, [b]The Battle for Vega[/b] is a must-play for fans of retro shooters. Get ready to blast your way through the galaxy and emerge victorious in the ultimate battle for Vega!

[h2]What's in the demo version?[/h2]

The demo version contains the first 3 player ships, most of hardpoint class 1 weapons, and selected hardpoint class 2 weapons. You can play through 15 levels up to the first boss - this includes bonus levels, and even HARD version of the boss.

On top of that you have a separated [b]Arcade Mode[/b] in which you play through the whole game with no credits, upgrades, or level directives. Each act has a predefined ship, so everybody plays on a plain field and can try to reach best time, or hi score.
